competitors.their_angle: Modern app, revenue-generating, explicit SpotShare replacement.
competitors.spotshare_counter: No per-transaction fees; simpler board approval path; SpotShare's model doesn't require residents to download a new app.

competitors.name: Community Boss / Parking Boss
competitors.description: Named Florida case study: Cypress Bend V (Pompano Beach) — 'How We Helped a Florida HOA Fix Their Resident Parking and Catch Illegal Renters.' Smart Decals + guest registration enforcement model. No St. Pete building confirmed.
competitors.their_angle: Enforcement + compliance — catches rule violators, not just manages guest access.
competitors.spotshare_counter: SpotShare's sharing model avoids adversarial enforcement entirely — no Smart Decals, no towing, no 'catching' residents. Amenity vs. enforcement framing.

competitors.name: ParkingPass
competitors.description: Generic Tampa area page (parkingpass.com/tampa-parking-software-provider) with regional claim. No named St. Pete condo case study. Digital permit issuance focus.
competitors.their_angle: Regional brand claim without local proof.
competitors.spotshare_counter: A named St. Pete building would beat a generic Tampa Bay page on every local search.

competitors.name: ParqEx / GuestParq
competitors.description: $3,500+/month operating income claim. Comparison pages vs. Parkade and Community Boss published. No St. Pete or Florida case study found.
competitors.their_angle: Revenue generation + enterprise access control.
competitors.spotshare_counter: SpotShare's peer-to-peer model is simpler — no per-transaction fee layer, no hardware.

competitors.name: SmartLotIQ
competitors.description: New entrant — ALPR + QR passes + gate control. $149–$399/month. No Florida presence confirmed.
competitors.their_angle: Hardware-first enforcement at gate level.
competitors.spotshare_counter: Requires construction disruption for hardware installation.

competitors.name: Proptia
competitors.description: New find — integrates parking enforcement with visitor access for HOAs and apartments. No Florida presence confirmed.
competitors.their_angle: Combined parking + visitor access control platform.
competitors.spotshare_counter: SpotShare doesn't require visitor credentialing — residents manage guest access peer-to-peer.
